{{actor|name=ovl_En_Zl2}}
'''ovl_En_Zl2''' is the [[Princess Zelda|Adult Zelda]] actor used for the Light Arrows cutscene. See also [[ovl_En_Zl3]], which is the Adult Zeldaa actor used for the "Tower Collapse" sequence at the end of the game.
{{clear}}
